content.Title: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Heart Failure Guideline
content.Summary: This document provides guidelines for evaluating heart failure, focusing on clinical assessments, risk factors, and various studies related to heart failure prediction, prognosis, and intervention. It emphasizes the importance of evaluating exercise consumption and function in predicting heart failure outcomes, assesses the risk of hospitalization for heart failure, and provides data on several trials and statistical models predicting heart failure outcomes.
Conditions Discussed: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
Blood pressure management in heart failure
